name: Cornucopia — Kingdom Cards & Prizes (in-development copy of the pinned catalog)
note: Development copy of src/data/cornucopia.json (Task 162 pin). cards.init loads this file instead of the pinned one while the set is in development, so the two must stay identical in roster and official text.

cards.name: Fairgrounds
cards.text: Worth 2 VP per 5 differently named cards you have (round down).

cards.name: Farming Village
cards.text: +2 Actions; Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Treasure or Action card. Put that card into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Fortune Teller
cards.text: +$2; Each other player reveals cards from the top of their deck until they reveal a Victory card or a Curse. They put it on top and discard the rest.

cards.name: Hamlet
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; You may discard a card, for +1 Action. You may discard a card, for +1 Buy.

cards.name: Harvest
cards.text: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck, then discard them. +$1 per differently named card revealed.

cards.name: Horn of Plenty
cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $1 per differently named card you have in play (counting this). If it's a Victory card, trash this.

cards.name: Horse Traders
cards.text: +1 Buy; +$3; Discard 2 cards. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first set this aside from your hand. If you do, then at the start of your next turn, +1 Card and return this to your hand.

cards.name: Hunting Party
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; Reveal your hand. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a card that isn't a copy of one in your hand. Put it into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Jester
cards.text: +$2; Each other player discards the top card of their deck. If it's a Victory card, they gain a Curse; otherwise, they gain a copy of the discarded card, or you do, your choice.

cards.name: Menagerie
cards.text: +1 Action; Reveal your hand. If the revealed cards all have different names, +3 Cards. Otherwise, +1 Card.

cards.name: Remake
cards.text: Do this twice: Trash a card from your hand, then gain a card costing exactly $1 more than it.

cards.name: Tournament
cards.text: +1 Action; Each player may reveal a Province from their hand. If you do, discard it and gain a Prize (from the Prize pile) or a Duchy, onto your deck. If no-one else does, +1 Card and +$1.

cards.name: Young Witch
cards.text: +2 Cards; Discard 2 cards. Each other player gains a Curse unless they reveal a Bane from their hand. Setup: Add an extra Kingdom card pile costing $2 or $3 to the Supply. Its cards are Banes.

cards.name: Bag of Gold
cards.text: +1 Action; Gain a Gold onto your deck. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Diadem
cards.text: +$1 per unused Action you have (Action, not Action card). (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Followers
cards.text: +2 Cards; Gain an Estate. Each other player gains a Curse and discards down to 3 cards in hand. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Princess
cards.text: +1 Buy; This turn, cards cost $2 less. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Trusty Steed
cards.text: Choose two: +2 Cards; +2 Actions; +$2; gain 4 Silvers and put your deck into your discard pile. The choices must be different. (This is not in the Supply.)
